in_hebrew.name: Barrow
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bright, shining hill
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Barrow הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English beorg or barrow, meaning 'hill' or 'barrow'. This name may have been given to someone living on a hill or to someone with a shining or bright personality. In the context of Christianity, it could be a reference to the hill where Jesus was crucified or the hill where He ascended into heaven.
